message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The errors are due to missing Mockito imports (Mockito not available). Likely we should remove Mockito usage and replace with simple implementations or not use mocking. Since tests are for JsonSchema.validate, we can avoid mocks by using a simple ExecutionContextCustomizer implementation (lambda) rather than mock. So we can remove @Mock parameters and use lambda directly. Also remove MockitoExtension and related imports. Also adjust ambiguous validate calls: basicSchema.validate(null, null) ambiguous because there are overloads. We need to call the correct method: validate(JsonNode, ExecutionContextCustomizer). For null customizer we can pass a lambda that does nothing? But test expects NPE when both null. Actually they want NPE when rootNode null or customizer null. The JsonSchema.validate method likely throws NPE if rootNode null or customizer null. There is overload validate(JsonNode) which doesn't take customizer. So calling basicSchema.validate(null, null) ambiguous. We can call basicSchema.validate(null, (ExecutionContextCustomizer) null) but ambiguous still? Need to cast. Use (ExecutionContextCustomizer) null.

Similarly for other ambiguous calls: basicSchema.validate(node, null) ambiguous. Use cast.

Remove Mockito static imports (verify, times, any, doThrow, doAnswer). Instead we can implement custom ExecutionContextCustomizer that records calls.

We need to test that customizer is called exactly once. We can create a custom class implementing ExecutionContextCustomizer that increments a counter.

Also need to test that customizer throws exception, etc.

We also need to replace ExecutionContext methods: setLocale, setFailFast, setAttribute. These are part of ExecutionContext. We'll need to call them via the customizer lambda; we can cast ExecutionContext to proper type and call methods. Should be fine.

Also need to adjust imports: remove Mockito imports, add any needed for ExecutionContextCustomizer.

Also need to import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger for counting.

Also need to import java.util.Locale.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Also need to fix usage of ValidationMessage.getPath(). The ValidationMessage class likely has getPath(). So that should compile. No issue.

Now ambiguous validate overloads: we will cast null to ExecutionContextCustomizer.

Also for validate with customizer that does nothing, we can use ctx -> {} lambda.

Now adjust test methods signatures: remove @Mock parameter, instead create customizer inside method.

But some tests rely on customizer being mocked to verify interactions; we can replace with custom implementation that records calls.

Implement a simple class TestCustomizer implements ExecutionContextCustomizer { int count=0; ExecutionContext lastCtx; @Override public void customize(ExecutionContext ctx) { count++; lastCtx = ctx; } }

Then we can assert count.

For tests that need to throw exception, we can create customizer that throws.

For locale test, customizer sets locale.

For failFast test, customizer sets failFast.

For null attribute key test, customizer sets attribute null to cause NPE.

Now adjust imports: import com.networknt.schema.ExecutionContext; import com.networknt.schema.ExecutionContextCustomizer; import com.networknt.schema.ValidationMessage; import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema; import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory; import com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion; import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaException;

Also need to import java.util.Set; etc.

Now adjust code.

Also remove duplicate import of MockitoExtension.

Now produce corrected code.
